tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm white, never pure white, so long reading sessions stay soft on the eyes.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and panels that sit on the page.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken fields: inputs, search, segmented controls, progress tracks.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm neutral band for the daily-rhythm rail, quiet section bands and selected chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, scripture and icons. 14.8:1 on surface-100 (light).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: excerpts, captions, metadata. 7:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, verse numbers, placeholders. 4.8:1 on surface-100; not for body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Working accent: links, active tab, primary button, progress, Prayer pillar. 5:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Sage tint behind a chip, badge, selected row or a prayer marker.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Reserved warm accent: the Word pillar, scripture references, verse-of-the-day eyebrow. One or two uses per screen.

tokens.name: bronze-soft
tokens.usage: Bronze tint for the verse-of-the-day band and Word chips.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Faith pillar: Bible study and teaching markers. Also the single destructive-action color.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Clay tint for Faith chips and study cards.

tokens.name: pillar-word
tokens.usage: Marker color for The Word: verse, scripture, Bible.

tokens.name: pillar-prayer
tokens.usage: Marker color for Prayer: declarations, prayer circle, fire prayer.

tokens.name: pillar-faith
tokens.usage: Marker color for Faith: studies, sermons, books, plans.

tokens.name: highlight-gold
tokens.usage: Bible highlight swatch 1 (behind ink).

tokens.name: highlight-sage
tokens.usage: Bible highlight swatch 2.

tokens.name: highlight-blush
tokens.usage: Bible highlight swatch 3.

tokens.name: highlight-sky
tokens.usage: Bible highlight swatch 4.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; card padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a stack; screen gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between Home sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a reading view; end-of-chapter breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, highlight swatches, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows in a group.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), the verse-of-the-day card, app icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, progress rings, the tab bar indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for floating layers: bottom sheets, the selection bar, toasts, the mini player. Cards never use shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: Top hairline of the tab bar.
